g.title: Handles GET /flights/search — queries Flight Service via REST, applies seat inventory filter, returns available flights with fare classes
Core domain component — generates IATA-format PNR (6-char alphanumeric), manages PNR state machine: PENDING→CONFIRMED→CHECKED_IN→BOARDED→CANCELLED
Manages seat availability per flight per fare class. Creates seat lock in Redis (8-min TTL). Converts lock to permanent assignment on payment confirmation.
Applies modification fees, cancellation refund policy, fare class rules. Reads fare_rules table. Returns computed fee amounts.
JPA/Hibernate repository — CRUD on bookings, passengers, seat_inventory tables. Handles optimistic locking to prevent double-booking.
Publishes domain events to Redis Streams: booking.confirmed, booking.cancelled, booking.modified — consumed by Notification Service and Payment Service
Spring State Machine — enforces valid transitions: PENDING→CONFIRMED (on payment), CONFIRMED→CHECKED_IN (on check-in), CONFIRMED→CANCELLED (on cancel). Rejects invalid transitions.
POST /payments/charge — receives Omise token, calls Omise Charge API, records transaction. Returns charge ID and status.
POST /payments/promptpay — calls Omise PromptPay API, receives QR payload, stores pending transaction. QR expires in 10 minutes.
POST /webhooks/omise — validates Omise HMAC signature, processes payment.capture.success / payment.fail events, triggers booking confirmation via REST call to Booking Service.
POST /payments/refund — calls Omise Refund API for card payments. Flags PromptPay refunds for manual bank transfer. Updates refunds table.
Cron job (daily 01:00 ICT) — aggregates transactions by payment method, computes net revenue, flags mismatches vs Omise dashboard, generates reconciliation report.
PostgreSQL CRUD on payments, transactions, refunds tables. No raw card data stored — only Omise charge IDs and masked card last-4.
